description.en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs.

description.zh:
您的拉流域名为用户的主播流域名。
> - 传入DomainName时，请保证传入域名为直播域名，同时调用本接口的用户拥有传入域名的操作权限。
description.en:
The streaming domain that you use for stream pulling.

> Ensure that the domain is a streaming domain and that you have the required permissions to manage it.

description.zh: 拉流结束时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内，且EndTime超过当前时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en:
The time when stream pulling ends.

The time range specified by the StartTime and EndTime parameters cannot exceed seven days. The time must be later than the current time. Specify the value in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 用户的直播流所在的源站完整url。多个源站可以填多个地址，用英文分号（;）分隔。
description.en: The origin URL of the live stream. You can specify multiple URLs. Separate them with semicolons (;).

description.zh: 拉流开始时间。 StartTime和EndTime时间间隔在7天内。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The time when stream pulling starts. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. It must be in UTC.
The name of the live stream.

descriptions.zh:
本接口目前适用于固定拉流。调用本接口更新直播拉流配置信息，包括源站地址、开始时间和结束时间。

> 调用本接口修改配置后，直播服务会按照修改后配置重新执行固定拉流，请确保修改操作不会影响线上业务。

## QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为1000次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
After this operation is complete, ApsaraVideo Live uses the updated settings for scheduled stream pulling. Make sure that the modification does not affect your business.

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per minute per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live update-live-pull-stream-info-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --source-url rtmp://guide.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000_rtmp://developer.aliyundoc.com/liveApp0000/liveStream0000 --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
